code:
import requests, re, numpy as np, matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---- caveolin-binding-motif scan restricted to each SCP/CAP domain ----
DOM={'P48060':('GLIPR1',38,175),'P16562':('CRISP2',41,169),'P54107':('CRISP1',45,175),
     'P54108':('CRISP3',43,171),'Q6UXB8':('PI16',37,165),'Q6UWM5':('GLIPR1L1',39,171),
     'P47032':('Pry1 (yeast)',167,281),'Q9H4G4':('GAPR-1',14,132),'A8PK52':('BmVAL-1 (B. malayi)',0,0)}
PATS={'CBM1 FxFxxxxF':'[WFY].[WFY].{4}[WFY]',
      'CBM2 FxxxxFxxF':'[WFY].{4}[WFY].{2}[WFY]',
      'CBM3 FxFxxxxFxxF':'[WFY].[WFY].{4}[WFY].{2}[WFY]'}
def seq(acc):
    t=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/{acc}.fasta",timeout=60).text
    return "".join(l.strip() for l in t.splitlines() if not l.startswith('>'))
cbm={}
for acc,(nm,s,e) in DOM.items():
    try: S=seq(acc)
    except Exception as ex: print(acc,'fetch failed',ex); continue
    if e==0: s,e=1,len(S)
    sub=S[s-1:e]
    hits=[]
    for pn,p in PATS.items():
        for m in re.finditer('(?=('+p+'))',sub):
            hits.append((pn,s+m.start(),m.group(1)))
    cbm[nm]=hits
    print(f"{nm:20s} domain {s}-{e}  {'NO CBM MATCH' if not hits else ''}")
    for pn,pos,mt in hits: print(f"    {pn:14s} {pos:4d} {mt}")

# ---- assemble the comparison table computed in this iteration ----
rows=[  # name, source, TM to tablysin, PLM clashes<2.8A, free ligand atoms, cav1 vol, cav1 hyd, best-hyd vol, best-hyd frac, residue at tablysin G129
 ("tablysin-15","xtal 3U3N",1.000,  0,18, 437,0.27, 166,0.74,"G129"),
 ("Pry1","xtal 5ETE",       0.727, 52, 0, 369,0.37,  75,0.62,"W230"),
 ("GAPR-1","xtal 1SMB",     0.677, 67, 0, 224,0.42, 224,0.42,"W83"),
 ("GLIPR1","xtal 3Q2U",     0.768, 58, 1, 422,0.45,  76,0.47,"W117"),
 ("GLIPR1","AF P48060",     0.810, 55, 1, 244,0.50, 244,0.50,"W117"),
 ("CRISP1","AF P54107",     0.858, 58, 0, 670,0.45,  64,0.73,"W119"),
 ("CRISP2","AF P16562",     0.832, 45, 4, 227,0.62, 227,0.62,"W114"),
 ("CRISP3","AF P54108",     0.829, 44, 5, 253,0.67, 253,0.67,"W116"),
 ("PI16","AF Q6UXB8",       0.831, 49, 1, 388,0.53,  85,0.62,"W106"),
 ("GLIPR1L1","AF Q6UWM5",   0.822, 72, 1, 217,0.68, 217,0.68,"W117"),
]
print("\n| protein | source | TM vs tablysin | palmitate contacts <2.8 A | ligand atoms with >=3.2 A clearance | largest cavity | hyd. frac | most hydrophobic cavity >=60 A^3 | hyd. frac | residue at tablysin Gly129 |")
print("|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|")
for r in rows:
    print(f"| {r[0]} | {r[1]} | {r[2]:.3f} | {r[3]} | {r[4]}/18 | {r[5]:.0f} A^3 | {r[6]:.2f} | {r[7]:.0f} A^3 | {r[8]:.2f} | {r[9]} |")

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,3,figsize=(17,5.2))
lab=[f"{r[0]}\n{r[1].split()[0]}" for r in rows]
known={'tablysin-15':'binds FA/LTE4','Pry1':'binds sterol + FA','CRISP2':'binds cholesterol'}
cols=['#1b7837' if r[0] in known else ('#b2182b' if r[0]=='GLIPR1' else '#777777') for r in rows]
ax[0].bar(range(len(rows)),[r[3] for r in rows],color=cols)
ax[0].set_xticks(range(len(rows))); ax[0].set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=90,fontsize=7)
ax[0].set_ylabel('palmitate heavy-atom contacts < 2.8 A')
ax[0].set_title('a. rigid palmitate transplant fails its controls\n(green = experimentally confirmed lipid binders)',fontsize=9)
ax[1].bar(range(len(rows)),[r[8] for r in rows],color=cols)
ax[1].axhline(0.5,color='k',ls=':',lw=1)
ax[1].set_xticks(range(len(rows))); ax[1].set_xticklabels(lab,rotation=90,fontsize=7)
ax[1].set_ylabel('hydrophobic lining fraction of most hydrophobic buried cavity')
ax[1].set_title('b. GLIPR1 has the least hydrophobic cavity\nof the six human CAP domains',fontsize=9)
afrows=[r for r in rows if r[1].startswith('AF')]
ax[2].scatter([r[7] for r in afrows],[r[8] for r in afrows],
              c=['#b2182b' if r[0]=='GLIPR1' else '#1b7837' if r[0] in known else '#2166ac' for r in afrows],s=70)
for r in afrows: ax[2].annotate(r[0],(r[7],r[8]),fontsize=8,xytext=(4,4),textcoords='offset points')
ax[2].set_xlabel('cavity volume (A^3)'); ax[2].set_ylabel('hydrophobic lining fraction')
ax[2].set_title('c. human CAP AlphaFold models, identical treatment\n(domain-trimmed, pLDDT >= 70)',fontsize=9)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
